name: Triumvirate
description: Armin Morov, Slavomir Zoltan and Maladola, who held power in Kaya's absence.

timeline.summary: Kaya meets the Orzhov Triumvirate, who refuse to commit forces and only offer an honor guard to the Senate.
timeline.quote: If our new guildmaster would lead the charge, I'm sure the church executioners would be pleased to provide her with an honor guard

timeline.summary: Power over the Syndicate falls to Teysa and the Triumvirate while Kaya is distracted.
timeline.quote: With Kaya distracted, the actual power over the Syndicate fell to Matriarch Teysa Karlov and the Triumvirate
